datasets.scope: 1,716 curated experiments from 119 papers up to 2018; frequencies per result set, not animals
datasets.evidence: File is a SQLite database. Row counts: Experiment 1,716; Publication 119 (years 2005-2018); Species 17 (Dugesia japonica, Schmidtea mediterranea, Girardia tigrina, Dugesia dorotocephala ...); Drug 37 (incl. Octanol, Heptanol, Hexanol); RNAi 412; ResultSet 2,000; ResultantMorphology 3,114 (each = a named morphology with a frequency per result set). 282 experiments have a resultant morphology whose name starts 'Double head'; 126 have 'Headless'; 45 experiments are linked through ExperimentDrug to octanol, heptanol or hexanol; 126 experiments use Dugesia dorotocephala. Publication titles include Nogi & Levin 2005 (innexins, gap-junctional communication) and Beane 2011 (H,K-ATPase voltage and head regeneration); no 2015 Emmons-Bell or 2019 Durant title appears in the 2014-2018 Publication list. Manipulations are stored as chained actions (Crop/Remove actions each reference a FromAction).

summary: No deposited lineage-level or serial-cutting table was found. PlanformDB can store chained manipulations but I did not verify any entry that records untreated re-cutting of a drug-induced double-head lineage; PMC papers give only published proportions.
next_step: Query PlanformDB for experiments with a drug action followed by two or more cut actions and no later drug (not done here), and request worm-level lineage tables from Oviedo/Levin-lab papers.
obstacles_confirmed: Round-by-round head counts are in the papers, not in a deposited lineage table.
Genome sequence of the altered lines is not deposited; wild-type genome is inferred from induction and reset experiments.
